name: team-task-manager
description: Role-aware team task manager built with React, Express, PostgreSQL, and Prisma.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.start: npm run db:deploy && npm run start --workspace apps/api
